name: DM542T stepper driver, signal terminal block (PUL/DIR/ENA/ALM)
blurb: The stepper driver that turns step pulses into motor current. Only its 8-way signal terminal is wired from the controller; motor and 24-36 V power are separate.

pins.name: PUL+
pins.note: Opto LED anode (Style 1 wiring: driven from the controller, matching minus pin to GND). With the driver's signal selector at 5 V, the opto needs about 4 V or more for a guaranteed ON; a 3.3 V GPIO is marginal. HARDWARE_SETUP.md: use a suitable 3.3 V-to-driver interface where the manual requires it.

pins.name: PUL-
pins.note: Opto return. Style 1: tie to controller GND.
